name: Priority Health Medicare (Corewell Health)
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public priorityhealth.com pages only (no sign-in). The Medicare 'Pay your premium' page: recurring EFT from a bank account or by credit/debit card, or Social Security deduction; one-time online by debit card, credit card or bank account, by phone or by mail; pay for another member by mail or with the guest pay option online; you can pay a full year ahead and still get monthly invoices showing a credit. EFT drafts for the premium due on the 1st are withdrawn within the first three business days; cancel in the member account if enrolled there, otherwise call Customer Service at least 30 days before the draft; change bank details under Pay My Premium (effective next month if received before the 25th); EFT can be scheduled months ahead. NSF fee up to $25 (Michigan limit). Grace periods 90 days (Medicare) and 60 days (Medigap). Mail: Priority Health, 3915 Momentum Place, Chicago, IL 60689-5339. Phone 888.389.6648 (TTY 711). Setting up a recurring payment stops the mailed monthly bill. The Go paperless page covers EOBs and plan notices (Profile > My profile > Settings & privacy > Settings > Email settings), not premium bills. The EFT draft window cannot be expressed exactly (autopay days left at default). Guest pay lookup fields are not shown publicly (family defaults). Sign-in identifier (username) is inferred; 'Login' and 'Sign up' are the page's labels. Review (tier-20): the Pay online page confirms card, debit card or bank account and says to omit the contract-number suffix; the payment site is a pop-up vendor window.

guest_pay.note: Use guest pay to pay for yourself or another member without logging in. Enter the contract number without its -XX suffix.

autopay.note: EFT payments for the premium due on the 1st are withdrawn within the first three business days of the month.

autopay_cancel.note: If you enrolled in your member account, cancel there. Otherwise call Customer Service at least 30 days before the draft date.

paperless.note: Choose email delivery of EOBs and plan notices in your account settings. Setting up recurring payments also stops the mailed monthly bill.

pay_by_mail.note: Mail to Priority Health, 3915 Momentum Place, Chicago, IL 60689-5339, one check per envelope with its invoice coupon.

payment_assistance.note: Check whether you qualify for help paying for Part D prescriptions.

notes: If a payment is returned for insufficient funds, a fee of up to $25 (the Michigan limit) may apply.

help.title: Pay your premium
paragraphs: Recurring: have your premium drafted by EFT from a bank account or charged to a credit or debit card, or have it deducted from your Social Security check.
One time: pay online by debit card, credit card or bank account, call 888.389.6648 (TTY 711), or mail your payment to Priority Health, 3915 Momentum Place, Chicago, IL 60689-5339.

Paying for someone else? Mail one check per envelope with that member's invoice coupon, or use guest pay online. You can also pay a full year ahead; your monthly invoices will show a credit until a payment is due.
Paying online without logging in? Enter your contract number without the suffix (the -XX at the end).

help.title: EFT recurring payments
paragraphs: Premiums are due on the 1st and EFT payments are withdrawn within the first three business days of the month. You can schedule EFT payments several months ahead in your member account.
To change your bank information, log in and select Pay My Premium; changes received before the 25th take effect the next month.
To cancel EFT, use your member account if you enrolled there. Otherwise call Customer Service at least 30 days before the scheduled draft date.

help.title: Late payments and grace periods
paragraphs: Coverage does not end the moment a payment is late. Medicare plans have a 90-day grace period and Medicare supplement (Medigap) plans have a 60-day grace period.
If a payment is returned for insufficient funds, a fee of up to $25 may apply.

help.title: Going paperless
paragraphs: Log in, open Profile and My profile, then Settings & privacy and Settings. Under Email settings choose Yes for Explanation of Benefits to get claim statements by email.
Once you set up recurring payments you no longer get a mailed monthly bill; informational invoices are available on request.

extra.intent: Using Priority Health's Medicare premium help, find how many days the grace period is for a Medicare plan premium. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Medicare plans have a 90-day grace period.
